snippet.title: How the Top 1% Use Claude Code Differently
snippet.description:
🚀Join the Agentic Academy: https://skool.com/scrapes
👀 Get customers from ChatGPT: https://dub.sh/rankspot-yt
Don't miss the next build - https://www.youtube.com/@simonscrapes?sub_confirmation=1

The way the top 1% use Claude Code has completely changed in the last year. Forget "plan mode", "think harder" and a lot of the conventions we were told in the last 6 months- all that advice is now obsolete. In this video, we break down the 10 new strategies the experts are using to build more autonomous and efficient systems. You'll learn the modern architecture for handing off work to Claude, ensuring it's done right, and running entire processes without your constant supervision.

00:00 - How the Top 1% Use Claude Code Differently
00:30 - 1. Plan mode is redundant
02:27 - 2. Stop picking an effort level
03:24 - 3. Checks Vs. Plans
05:06 - 4. Autonomous first with /goal
07:07 - 5. Turn CLAUDE.md into an index
10:00 - 6. Only Skill what Claude got wrong
13:37 - 7. No Skill beats Skill 7/9 times
14:48 - 8. Put must-hold rules in a hook
16:50 - 9. Let Claude build its own agent team
